Name: Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
This MOD is to provide basic matching portraits and sprites that you can use them in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family (Portraits Version)[/url] for a more immersive experience. This MOD contains generic portraits and sprites with matching colors of the vanilla spouses.

[b][u]Required MODs:[/u][/b]
1) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[b][u]
Use instructions:
[/u][/b]To let the children use the [b]sprites and portraits[/b] in the events and dialogues from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family (Portraits Version)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url]:
1) Please download the main file and put into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.
2) [b][u]Please set the config using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] before loading your save game[/u][/b]. Please also note that you need to change the config every time loading a save game with different spouse and children:
[spoiler]
[b]LightBaby[/b] - You can choose who the light-skinned baby looks like here.
[b]DarkBaby[/b]- You can choose who the dark-skinned baby looks like here.
[b]DarkerBabySkin[/b]- If false, it uses dark skin tone for the dark-skinned baby. If true, it uses darker skin tone.

[b]BoySkin[/b] - Choose the skin tone of the toddler boy.
[b]BoyHair[/b]- You can choose who the light-skinned toddler boy looks like here.
[b]GirlSkin[/b] - Same as above for the girl.
[b]GirlHair[/b]- Same as above for the girl.

[b]BoyName[/b]- Fill the boy's name here. Must be exactly same with the name in your save. Otherwise won't load correctly for Unique Children Talk.
[b]GirlName[/b]- Same as above for the girl.[/spoiler]
3) Please[b] tick [/b]the [b]UsePortraitMOD[/b] config option for [b]Immersive Family[/b].

-----
*If you want to use the [b]portraits only[/b] (not using the sprite), please download the [b]Portrait Pack[/b]:
For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url]:
- Find the portraits you want to use and[b] Copy[/b].
- [b]Paste[/b] in the [b]assets/Portrait[/b] folder in [b]UniqueChildren Talk[/b] and [b]rename[/b] it according to your [b]children's name[/b].

For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family (Portraits Version)[/url] :
- Find the portraits you want to use
- [b]Duplicate and Rename[/b] the portrait files to [b]Toddler[/b] and [b]Toddler_Girl
[/b]- Please copy the portraits and paste them in the [b]assets\Portraits[/b] folder in the [b]Immersive Family MOD folder[/b]. You need to[b] replace[/b] the files there.
- Please also ensure that [b]UsePortraitMOD[/b] is [b]not ticked[/b] under config for [b]Immersive Family[/b].
----[b]

[b][u]Optional Alternative MOD:
[/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27513]Nyapu's style portraits[/url]﻿[/b]

Downloads.Description:
Added children's portraits and sprites for Alissa, Blair, Corine, Flor, Ian, Irene, Jeric, Jio, June, Philip, Shiro, Ysabelle and Zayne from RSV

Please remember to set the config before loading the save game.
This file contains portraits only, for those who want to use the portraits only, as you may probably use the portraits with other children sprite changing mods.
